description_en: Dissociates a mitigation policy from a protected object
description_zh: 防护对象取消关联防护策略
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp detach-from-policy --policy-type l3 --ip-port-protocol-list PortRange=80-90 Ip=47.118.172.000 Port=80 Protocol=tcp --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachFromPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The policy type. Valid values:
default: default mitigation policy.
l3: IP-specific mitigation policy.
l4: port-specific mitigation policy
parameters.help_zh:
策略类型。取值
default：表示默认防护策略
l3：表示IP防护策略
l4：表示端口防护策略
parameters.name: policy_type

fields.help_en: The IP address of the protected object
fields.name: ip

fields.help_en: The port of the protected object
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The port range of the protected object.
Only port-specific mitigation policies support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
防护对象的端口范围。
仅端口防护策略支持
fields.name: port_range

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the protected object. Valid values:

tcp: Transmission Control Protocol.
udp: User Datagram Protocol
fields.help_zh:
防护对象的协议类型，取值：

tcp：表示传输控制协议。
udp：表示用户数据报协议
fields.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The version of the port-specific mitigation policy. Valid values:

Not specified: dissociates the default surf anti-DDoS engine policy.
2: dissociates the new stream anti-DDoS engine policy.
Only port-specific mitigation policies support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
端口防护策略版本，取值：

不填：解绑默认 surf 防护引擎策略。
2：解绑新版 stream 防护引擎策略。
仅端口防护策略支持
parameters.name: port_version

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
